question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Allmost**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the word "allmost" is incorrect. 
 
• **The correct spelling of the word is "almost."**
 
• The incorrect spelling "allmost" is a common misspelling due to the similar sounding "all" and "al" in the word.
 
• **The word "almost" means very nearly, quite.**
 
 
• Example: They almost missed the bus.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "Treble," refers to a musical term that means triple or threefold.
 
• Option 2, "Nozzle," refers to a device used to control the flow or direction of a liquid or gas.
 
• Option 4, "Moisture," refers to a small amount of water or other liquid present in the air or a substance.
